cultural.vision_reason: Documentary photograph of Sitka chiefs in fur regalia, fur hats, and woven ceremonial garments, captioned "Sitka, Group of distinguished Chiefs" — consistent with Tlingit dress and material culture at Sitka, Alaska.

physical.title: stereoscope photograph (black and white)
physical.summary:
Stereoscope photograph (black and white); group of five Tlingit(?) chiefs sitting on a wooden balcony, with the sea in the background; the chief on the far left is wearing a fur hat and a fur garment over his back; the chief second from the left is wearing an embroidered headdress with feathers, a fur cape, and has his face painted; the chief sitting in the centre is wearing a fur hat, an embroidered fur(?) jumper with tassels, face paint, is smoking a pipe, and is touching a fur garment in the centre of the group; the chief second from the right is wearing a fur hat, a woven embroidered jumper, face paint, and is smoking a pipe; the chief on the far right is wearing an embroidered hat, an embroidered fur and tassel jumper, face paint, and is holding a rattle or tambourine; Sitka, United States of America.
